# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), [`docs/MASTER-ENGINEERING-PROMPT.md`](../docs/MASTER-ENGINEERING-PROMPT.md), [`docs/EXECUTION-PLAN.md`](../docs/EXECUTION-PLAN.md), and [`docs/AI-HANDOFF.md`](../docs/AI-HANDOFF.md). Resume the first unblocked task; avoid repeated broad audits and status narration.

Never use Git CLI/GitHub CLI, official Figma MCP, paid inference APIs, remote prompt execution, or unvalidated model output. Preserve provider-neutral manual import and optional loopback Ollama. Keep all Figma mutations in the plugin adapter. Run relevant tests and update the feature registry, README task/progress table and handoff with honest evidence.
